events.text: Diagnosed live on Van Seat: create-face bridge rejects the side-edge pair because selectedEdgesReferenceNormalPub (mesh_edit.zig:1656) requires the two selected edges' adjacent authored face normals to agree (dot>0). The hole sits in a recess: left/right neighbors are opposing flank walls, dot=-0.467 -> reject; top/bottom neighbors both face outward, dot=+0.772 -> accept. Same quad either way; the gate samples different neighbors per pair.

resolution: Diagnosed live on the Van Seat model why the same quad bridged from the top/bottom edge pair but not the side pair: selectedEdgesReferenceNormalPub requires the two selected edges' adjacent authored face normals to agree (dot > 0). The hole sits in a recess, so the side pair samples the two opposing flank walls (dot -0.467, rejected) while the top/bottom pair samples the agreeing outward faces (dot +0.772, accepted). Fixed under req_3840 (sha e0595047d) per the user's ruling.
